title: Modern Compass
description: This extremely simple mod adds a compass on the screen to show directions.
body:
这是一个极其简单的模组，它会在屏幕上显示一个罗盘(见图库)。
应该不会和其他模组有冲突，因为它很简单。
大部分配置应该可以正常运作。
目前来看，不会移植到Fabric或其他Minecraft版本。
制作模组的过程中使用了AI。
我是个学生，我不一定有技术和时间解决兼容问题，除非问题真的影响到我了。

---

This is an extremely simple mod that displays a compass on the screen (see gallery).
It shouldn’t conflict with other mods because it’s very straightforward.
Most configurations are likely to work properly.
Currently, there are no plans to port to Fabric or other Minecraft versions.
AI was used during the mod’s development.
I’m a student, and I may not have the technical skills or time to address compatibility issues unless they really affect me.
